parsedContent.method: Recognize that co‑interior (same‑side interior) angles formed by a transversal intersecting parallel lines are supplementary, so their measures add to 180°. Set up the equation (3x+10)+(2x+30)=180, combine like terms, isolate x, then substitute the found x back into each angle expression to obtain the numeric measures.
keyPoints: Form the equation (3x+10)+(2x+30)=180 and simplify to 5x+40=180.
Substitute x into each angle expression to get the two angle measures.
Both computed angles should add to 180°, confirming correctness.
